description: Save manual remark entry from list (Remarks screen, Figma 19230:57867). All entry data in request; response is save result only.

notes.list: GET subject-profile/19230-58386--manual-remark-list.json to load studentCard, skills[] cards, and Overall Remarks form.
notes.save: POST full request body on Save or Save and Next — context fields + skills[] (skillId + remark per card) + overallRemarks + selectedSuggestionIds.
notes.saveAndNext: After successful POST, client navigates to studentCard.nextStudentId from list response.
notes.suggestions: selectedSuggestionIds from student-profile/19230-57627--remarks-suggestions-list.json when Suggestions is used on Overall Remarks.
